**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

Section 9 delivers the preferred T4C bargain in full:

- **Customer convenience right (Agreement or Order Form):** § 9.4 — "Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form without cause."
- **Notice ≤ 30 days:** § 29.4 fixes the § 9.4 notice period at "thirty days before the effective termination date."
- **Pro-rata refund, no penalty:** § 9.4 — "Customer owes only accrued Fees, and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees for the period after termination," reinforced by § 10.2. No early-termination fee appears anywhere.
- **No Vendor convenience right:** Vendor's termination rights are confined to material uncured breach (§ 9.1), insolvency (§ 9.2), and infringement mitigation for the affected item only (§ 20, which expressly bars terminating unaffected Services). § 8.2 gives only Customer the non-renewal election (a RENEWAL mechanic, not flagged here), and § 24.4 denies Vendor any termination right on Customer's change of control.
